title: Sable Mob Paths
summary: Mobs walk onto, off and between Sable ships and trains, and villagers live and work on them.

screenshots.title: Carriage to carriage
screenshots.description: Illagers on one carriage of a Dungeon Train spot a villager on the next.

screenshots.title: Across the gap
screenshots.description: A moment later they have crossed onto the next carriage.

screenshots.title: Boarding a ship
screenshots.description: Illagers walk up a dock and onto a Sable ship to reach the villagers on deck.

screenshots.title: Villagers at work on deck
screenshots.description: A farmer, librarian and fisherman use the job sites on the ship they live on.
